**Bad-MAC registration after security mode is dropped**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | NAS / NAS security / Integrity protection of NAS signalling messages |
| Tags | negative, security |
| Verdict class | FAIL |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 35s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | main |
| Needs | NG Setup, registration, PDU session establishment |

## Clauses

- TS 24.501 4.4.4.3 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-15: V15.0.0 to V16.2.0 have one REGISTRATION REQUEST rule ("only a PDU session for non-emergency services" and a HASHAMF IE in V15.0.0) and "the AMF shall authenticate the subscriber before processing the registration request any further"; Rel-16: V16.3.0 splits the rule into initial registration and mobility and periodic registration update, with the RINMR bit; Rel-18: V18.0.0 adds "If authentication procedure is not successful the AMF shall maintain, if any, the 5GMM-context and 5G NAS security context unchanged"; "subclause" becomes "clause")

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NAS-BADMAC-REGISTRATION-AFTER-SMC.md).
